verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Dataverse Web API with rich operations (CRUD, batch, FetchXML, ETags). None of it mentions API versioning, version numbers in endpoints, or a deprecation or support-lifecycle policy. Having an API is adjacent to this story; it does not show versioning or a deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
